goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown, type operator ID 'teller1', type password 'password', click Sign On. Click 'Member Inquiry', type member number '100234' into the search value field, click Search, click 'Select'. On the member record page, click 'Open New Share'. The required field labels are prefixed with an asterisk, e.g. '* Share Type', '* Initial Deposit' -- use those exact label texts (without the trailing colon) as the 'name' argument. Use the select tool to choose 'S0001 - Regular Shares' as '* Share Type'. Type '50.00' into '* Initial Deposit'. Click 'Continue' to reach the confirmation review screen (heading 'CONFIRM NEW SHARE'). Then click 'Open Share' to actually open the share for real (this is sandbox data, completing it for real is fine and required). After the share opens, extract the confirmation number (the value next to the 'Confirmation:' label) as an output named confirmation_number. Then immediately call done referencing that output -- do not take any extra steps first.
